fields.description: When ticked, each new case goes to the officer whose desk matches its category, area and provider. Untick to send every case to the officer(s) on the Unrouted desk for manual triage.
fields.label: Route Cases to Matching Officers

fields.description: Cases and change requests move up the chain when their deadline passes.
fields.label: Escalation

fields.description: Untick to stop automatic escalation of overdue cases site-wide. Each SLA Configuration can also switch it off for its own category.
fields.label: Escalate Overdue Cases Automatically

fields.description: Hours an unanswered change request waits with an approver before it moves one rung up. A rung's own escalation hours take precedence.
fields.label: Change Request Wait (Hours)

fields.description: A new grievance is compared with the same submitter's earlier ones. Each pair scores description similarity (weight = 1 minus the category and type weights) plus the category and type weights when those match. Tune the values below from the confirm and dismiss rulings officers record.
fields.label: Duplicate Detection

fields.description: When ticked, a web portal submitter who files a grievance similar to one of their own from the last 24 hours is asked whether it is a new grievance (the API answers 409 POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE until the request is sent again with confirm_new). Tick only once the web client handles that answer. Cases are flagged for officer review either way.
fields.label: Ask Before Filing a Similar Grievance

fields.description: Score added when both grievances have the same service category.
fields.label: Same Category Weight

fields.description: Score added when both grievances have the same grievance type.
fields.label: Same Type Weight

fields.description: A pair scoring at least this is flagged for officer review. The category and type weights together must stay below it, or matching labels alone would flag a grievance.
fields.label: Flag Threshold

fields.description: A flagged pair scoring at least this is shown to officers as a High match, otherwise Medium.
fields.label: High Match Threshold

fields.description: Base URL of the Farmer Registry Staff API. Leave blank to turn off the farmer search on the intake form.
fields.label: Staff API URL

fields.description: The register the farmer search reads, sent as register_id and subject_register_id.
fields.label: Farmer Register ID
